_about: Corrections to Questie's Forever quest data, looked up by hand (one quest at a time). preAny: one of these must be turned in first; preAll: all of them; exclusive: mutually exclusive quests (drop the other chain); drop: omit from leveling routes. They are added to what the data already says.

338.name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn
338.why: Completing Green Hills requires the four bound Chapters rewarded by turning in Chapters I-IV (339-342). Tying them keeps the chain consistent across quest modes and avoids holding 338 in the quest log while gathering pages.

339.name: Chapter I
339.why: Offered by Barnil Stonepot after Welcome to the Jungle (583).

340.name: Chapter II
340.why: Offered by Barnil Stonepot after Welcome to the Jungle (583).

341.name: Chapter III
341.why: Offered by Barnil Stonepot after Welcome to the Jungle (583).

342.name: Chapter IV
342.why: Offered by Barnil Stonepot after Welcome to the Jungle (583).

1367.name: Magram Alliance
1367.why: Desolace Magram vs Gelkis centaur tribes are mutually hostile in play; routes follow Gelkis (1368/1382) so you aren't sent back and forth between hostile camps.

1385.name: Brutal Politics
1385.why: Desolace Magram vs Gelkis centaur tribes are mutually hostile in play; routes follow Gelkis (1382/1368) so you aren't sent back and forth between hostile camps.

79953.name: A Ludite's Guide to Caring for Your Demonic Pet
79953.why: Mage Librarian (Owen Thadd / Garion Wendell) spell-note book quest missing zoneOrSort=-284 in QuestieDB; not a general Swamp of Sorrows leveling quest.

81951.name: The Liminal and the Arcane
81951.why: Mage Librarian (Owen Thadd / Garion Wendell) spell-note book quest missing zoneOrSort=-284 and finishedBy in QuestieDB; Owen Thadd does not offer it as a general Feralas leveling quest.

95183.name: Step One: Rock
95183.why: Riverglades, Horde: Gorgegut and Hamur don't offer it until Land of Giants (95420) is done, which opens the Bolder'ok ogre quests. Questie lists no prerequisite. Source: player reports on Wowhead's quest page and Onward users, 2026-11-17. Not confirmed in game by us.

98426.name: REUSEME
98426.why: Unimplemented placeholder quest with no giver, turn-in, or objectives.
